bullets.title: AMD: Blowout Q4 Guide + 80%+ CY27 Growth on AI Data Center Ramp
bullets.body: AMD Q3 revenue $13.4B beat consensus; data center revenue +97% YoY to $8.5B with Helios GPU now shipping to Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Oracle. Q4 guidance $17B (+/- 3%) well above Street's $16.2B. Management guides CY27 revenue growth >80% YoY with data center representing ~80% of total revenue; server CPU expected to more than double. Roth, Piper, and D.A. Davidson all maintain Buy with $650 PT.

bullets.title: ANET: +11% AH on 38-40% FY27 Guide; AI Revenue Doubling to $7B
bullets.body: Arista Q3 revenue grew ~58% YoY with Q4 guidance well above consensus; FY27 revenue guided +38-40% YoY vs. ~30% Street expectation, with AI revenue expected to double to $7B. GS raised FY27/28 EPS by 10% to $6.13/$7.83. Citi and Piper reiterate Buy; Piper PT $261, Citi PT $248. Company is involved in 10GW+ of AI accelerator deployments across 10+ accelerator types.

bullets.title: SMCI: Triple-Digit Revenue Growth; FY27 Guide Raised to $72-82B but Margin Risk Flagged
bullets.body: SMCI Q1 EPS $1.81 vs. $1.23 consensus; revenue $19.95B vs. $17.53B est. FY27 revenue guidance raised to $72-82B from prior $65-72B. Key concerns: FY26 H2 gross margin implied at 11.8-12.2% (compression), and one customer represents 44% of revenues. Stock +8.9% pre-market.

bullets.title: W: Strong 3Q Beat; UBS Upgrades to Buy with $156 PT on Double-Digit Share Gains
bullets.body: Wayfair Q3 revenue $3.42B (+9.7% YoY, strongest post-COVID growth); U.S. revenue +11.4% vs. flat category, implying double-digit share gains. Adj. EPS $0.93 beat $0.80 consensus; adj. EBITDA $236M beat $225M. Active customers grew for a third consecutive quarter to 22.2M (+4.7% YoY); orders +12.2% YoY. UBS upgrades to Buy with $156 PT (19x FY28E EBITDA). International remains a drag at -2.3% revenue. Stock +5.8% pre-market.

bullets.title: DDOG: Largest-Ever Revenue Beat but Q4 Guide Implies Near-Flat Q/Q Growth; Stock -18%
bullets.body: Datadog Q3 revenue $1,197M beat by $53M (35% YoY); EBIT margin 27.9% beat consensus 23.4%. However, Q4 guidance implies only ~25% YoY growth (flat Q/Q vs. typical +7-8% seasonal ramp), flagging a large-customer optimization headwind. FY26 revenue guide raised $60M to ~$4,520M. KeyBanc PT $320 (Buy); JPM maintains Overweight at $305. The deceleration narrative is dominating — stock down 17.8% pre-market.

bullets.title: BKNG: Q3 Beat but Q4 Nights Guide +1-3% Well Below Expectations; KeyBanc Cuts PT 18% to $197
bullets.body: Booking Q3 gross bookings $54.5B beat estimates; adj. EBITDA $4.61B beat. Revenue missed by $900M due to FTC-related Priceline reduction. Q4 room-night growth guided +1-3% YoY vs. expectations of +3-5%, citing Middle East conflict, European civil unrest, and US macro softness. KeyBanc cuts PT to $197 from $240 (Overweight maintained); OPCO sees 12x '27E EPS as attractive entry. Stock +4.4% pre-market despite Q4 concerns.

bullets.title: HUT: Texas Election Creates Permitting Risk at Beacon Point; UBS/Roth Both Maintain Buy
bullets.body: HUT 3Q revenue $71M (below UBS $80M est); EBITDA $33M beat $23.8M consensus. Democrat Hinojosa's Texas governor victory likely triggers a data center permitting moratorium pending Jan-May 2027 legislative session, creating risk to Beacon Point Phase 1 (3Q27 target). Company raised buyback authorization to $1B; repurchased 3.3M shares. Roth (Buy, $108 PT) notes Texas moratorium targets new permits, not projects under construction. UBS maintains Buy.

bullets.title: WULF: Google Credit Backstop Secured for $19B Anthropic Kentucky Data Center Lease
bullets.body: TeraWulf executed credit support agreements with Google LLC for debt financing underpinning ~$19B in Anthropic lease commitments at its Justified Data Campus in Kentucky. Fluor EPC agreement executed for three data center buildings with guaranteed maximum pricing. Initial capacity expected H2 2027, ramping to 401 MW by early 2028. WULF seen as insulated from Texas permitting risk relative to TX-focused peers.

bullets.title: Midterm Election: Democrat Sweep Creates Data Center Permitting Risk; Bearish for TX-Focused AI Infrastructure
bullets.body: Democrats winning House (231+ seats), Senate (54+), and key governorships (Texas) creates near-term headwinds for data center buildout — potentially affecting ~45% of planned US capacity (GS estimate). Multiple states moving toward moratoriums (TX, GA, OH, MI, NM). Consensus: bearish for TX-heavy names (VST, CEG, GEV, NVDA/AVBO on delivery timing); constructive for non-TX powered shells (WULF, HUT Kentucky assets) and compute platforms (CRWV, NBIS, ORCL) as supply/demand pushes further out.

bullets.title: ORCL: Cancels $7B Tencent AI Chip Deal After Trump Administration Pressure; Stock -4.9%
bullets.body: Oracle canceled a $7B chip leasing arrangement with Tencent following pressure from the Trump administration and Chinese regulatory scrutiny. Stock down 4.9% pre-market. Separately, some analysts view ORCL as a potential beneficiary of compute futures as domestic data center buildout slows.

bullets.title: SHOP: GMV Misses Buyside at +29.5% YoY vs. +33-34% Expected; Q4 Guide Maintains Low-30s Growth
bullets.body: Shopify Q3 GMV grew +29.5% YoY, missing buyside expectations of +33-34%; revenue +32% also slightly below +34-35% estimates. Q4 guide maintains low-thirties revenue growth and high-twenties gross profit growth. Notably, AI-driven orders growing 3.3x and converting 64% more than organic. D.A. Davidson maintains Buy citing platform economics at scale.

bullets.title: NYT: Q3 Beat on Subscriptions; Digital Ads Miss First Time in Seven Quarters
bullets.body: NYT Q3 EPS $0.68 beat $0.64 consensus; digital-only subscription revenue +14.6% YoY with 420K net adds. Digital ad revenue missed by 4% — first miss after six consecutive beats — and Q4 digital ad guide (HSD to LDD growth) came below consensus of +15%. Citi maintains Buy at $85 PT; stock +3.9% pre-market.

bullets.title: UBER: 20% FXN GBs Growth; Mobility Decel on Driver Supply/ME Conflict; AVs 2K by End-2027
bullets.body: Uber Q3 gross bookings $59.8B (+20% FXN) in line; Delivery accelerated to +23% FXN while Mobility decelerated to +17% FXN (vs. +20% in Q2) on Middle East conflict (75bps headwind) and international driver supply tightness. Q4 GBs guided $63.25-$65.25B; EPS guided $0.95-$0.99 (~37% YoY). AV fleet targets 700 by end-2026 and 2,000 by end-2027. Non-GAAP EPS $0.88 beat Street.

bullets.title: AAPL: Downgraded to Sell at DZ Bank (PT $300); Margin Pressure from Rising Memory Costs Cited
bullets.body: DZ Bank cut AAPL to Sell from Hold and lowered PT to $300 from $310. Separately, analysts note rising memory costs are pressuring Apple's margins. SWKS data shows Apple was 62% of SWKS revenue in September quarter, with strong seasonal demand, but Android weakness is a broader concern.

bullets.title: ADBE: Downgraded to Sell at Citi; PT Cut to $207 from $250
bullets.body: Citi downgraded Adobe to Sell from Neutral and cut its price target to $207 from $250, citing competitive pressure and deteriorating outlook.

bullets.title: DIS: Morgan Stanley Raises PT to $133; Cruise Expansion to Drive Double-Digit EPS Growth
bullets.body: MS raises DIS PT from $125 to $133 (OW reiterated) on cruise line expansion from 6 to 13 ships by decade-end. DCL projects ~$5B revenue and ~$1.5B EBIT (~30% margins) in FY27. Each incremental ship adds $600-700M revenue and >$200M EBIT. Bull case $152 on 18x FY28E EPS of $8.32.

bullets.title: MRVL Acquiring LITE; Announced Pre-Market
bullets.body: Marvell Technology is acquiring Lumentum in a deal announced overnight, per Jefferies. No terms disclosed in the note. Both are relevant to the AI optical interconnect supply chain.

bullets.title: TLN/VST/CEG: Down 6-8% on Election; GS Sees Value at Current Levels
bullets.body: Power/data center utility names TLN, VST, and CEG fell 6-8% pre-market on Democratic state wins (Texas governor, Virginia) increasing data center regulatory risk. GS maintains Buy on TLN ($50 PT) post-Q3; MS sees VST undervalued at $140 vs. $180 fair value and CEG at $263 vs. $249 ex-PJM upside. TLN and CEG viewed as more defensively positioned given PJM exposure vs. Texas-heavy peers.

bullets.title: ALAB: Beat + Q4 Guidance 12% Ahead; Scorpio Fabric Switch Ramp; Stock -7.7% Pre-Market
bullets.body: Astera Labs delivered a clean beat with Q4 guidance 12% ahead of Street and 100bps gross margin upside. Despite the beat, stock is -7.7% pre-market, likely on broader AI infrastructure sentiment from election results. Roth maintains Buy with $350 PT citing strong Scorpio Fabric Switch ramp in 2H26; Jefferies also bullish.

bullets.title: SNAP/HUBS/EXPE/NET/CHTR: Key Earnings Tonight After Close
bullets.body: Several universe names report after the close tonight: SNAP (EPS $0.00 est, revenue $1.73B), HUBS (EPS $3.27 est, revenue $925.5M), EXPE (EPS $8.85 est, revenue $4.73B), NET (EPS $0.34 est, revenue $737.2M), CHTR reports Thursday morning (EPS $9.51 est, revenue $13.53B).
